summary: The customer wants to know if fiber probes can be used in dissolution vessels to monitor the release of two active ingredients over time.

facts_stated.text: They run dissolution tests on a tablet releasing two active ingredients in a QC lab.

facts_stated.text: They currently take manual samples at fixed times and analyze them by HPLC.
